final_message:
Wrote the compliance gap memo, `gap-analysis-memorandum.docx`; it validates and parses back cleanly. It finds at least 30 departures from the ROD and Consent Decree. Three need a ROD Amendment: the 1,4-dioxane level goes from 0.35 to 3.5 µg/L, the AOP unit is dropped, and groundwater cleanup is projected at 45 years instead of 30. The RAWP also says the pre-design investigation supports its cuts, but that memo recommends keeping the ROD specs.
